site.name: Pavlo Pukha
site.bio: Senior 3D Artist. 15+ years across games, VR/AR, and product visualization. Characters, hard surface, environments — full pipeline.

projects.title: Samurai
projects.fullDescription: A 17th century Samurai model crafted with historical accuracy and creative design liberties. Modeled over many afterwork evenings and weekends — a test of patience and craft. Full high-to-low poly pipeline, ZBrush sculpting, and PBR texturing in Substance Painter.

projects.title: Toyota Sprinter Trueno AE86
projects.fullDescription: High-fidelity hard surface recreation of the iconic AE86 Trueno. Full exterior and partial interior detail, game-ready topology, PBR materials.

projects.title: Stylised Knight
projects.fullDescription: Stylized game-ready knight character with full armor set. Designed for mobile/indie game pipelines with optimized poly count and atlased textures.

projects.title: Misc Characters & Sketches
projects.fullDescription: A collection of character studies, quick sculpts, and design explorations. Primarily ZBrush-based, covering anatomy practice and stylization experiments.

projects.title: Girl's Portrait
projects.fullDescription: Stylized portrait sculpt exploring expressive character design. Focus on surface detail, skin texture, and hair groom in a semi-realistic style.

projects.title: Till Lindemann
projects.fullDescription: Likeness portrait of Till Lindemann. Focused on accurate facial structure, skin detail, and capturing the subject's distinctive features.

projects.title: Black Widow Spider
projects.fullDescription: Detailed creature model of a Black Widow spider. High-poly sculpt baked down to a game-ready mesh with PBR textures.

projects.title: Comic Project Girl
projects.fullDescription: Stylized comic-style character model. Exaggerated proportions and bold silhouette designed for a graphic novel / animated series aesthetic.

projects.title: Kiki's Delivery Service
projects.fullDescription: Fan art tribute to Ghibli's Kiki's Delivery Service. Stylized character model capturing the warmth and charm of the original anime design.

projects.title: Stylized Environment
projects.fullDescription: Stylized game-ready environment scene. Modular asset kit with full PBR material suite, optimized for real-time rendering in Unreal Engine.
